    "chunk_summary": "SDMX section 3.1 enumerates three process patterns for statistical data/metadata exchange (bilateral, gateway, data-sharing), positions the SDMX standards and central registry services as support for a data-sharing process, discusses dissemination and data quality aspects, then opens 3.2 with three automated process types (batch exchange, internet provision, generic processes)."
  },

    {
      "id": "c2",
      "name": "Bilateral exchange",
      "aliases": ["bilateral exchange"],

    },
    {
      "id": "c3",
